QUOTE: "Calls `client.createPost` with the same content, again with no automatic retry. ... On failure, it either removes the post (for the same three error IDs) or sets `failed: true` again."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says `retryFailedPost` makes a single `client.createPost` call with no automatic retry, and on failure it removes the post for the same three errors or marks it failed again.
